_note: Verified against official Government of India sources as of July 2026. Numbers, portals and legal citations must not be altered.

helplines.name: National Cyber Crime Helpline
helplines.description: 24/7 financial cyber-fraud helpline, I4C (Ministry of Home Affairs). Call within the golden hour to freeze the destination account.

helplines.name: National Emergency Number
helplines.description: Police, ambulance and fire — single national emergency number.

helplines.name: National Consumer Helpline
helplines.description: Consumer grievances, including deficient service by banks and payment providers.

helplines.name: TRAI DND / Spam Complaints
helplines.description: Report unsolicited commercial calls and SMS; DND registration.

portals.name: NCRP — National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
portals.description: File your cyber-fraud complaint online; get a complaint ID.

portals.name: Chakshu — Report Suspected Fraud Communication
portals.description: Report fraud calls and SMS to DoT; numbers can be blocked across networks.

portals.name: Sanchar Saathi (DoT)
portals.description: Telecom safety services, including RICWIN for international spoofed numbers.

portals.name: RBI Ombudsman (CMS)
portals.description: Escalation when a bank refuses to act on an unauthorised transaction.

portals.name: I4C — Indian Cyber Crime Coordination Centre
portals.description: The MHA body that operates 1930 and the CFCFRMS system.

legal_sections.summary: Electronic summons must be encrypted, digitally signed and bear a court seal — never served by a phone call.
Impersonating a public servant — up to 2 years' imprisonment.
Forgery — covers fake FIRs and fake warrants.
Zero FIR — any police station must register your complaint regardless of jurisdiction.
Cheating by personation using a computer resource.
Zero customer liability if an unauthorised transaction is reported within 3 working days; limited liability within 4–7 days; no protection after 7 days.
